name: OpenVibe.Inventory

exposure.note: planned (ADR-054, plan T21 step 1); nothing is built or deployed yet. Live's cosmetics stay in Live until the migration in ADR-054 §8.

liveness.none: not built yet; nothing listens on a loopback address

shutdown.none: not built yet; nothing runs or drains

rollback.none: not built yet; nothing is released or rolled back

notes: The network-wide inventory (ADR-054): item kinds (a contract plus a renderer per surface), definitions (itd_), instances (inv_), the equipped set and an append-only ledger, in its own PostgreSQL database (ov_inventory, loopback 5030). Issuers (services, apps, creators) grant within their namespace; no selling, buying, trading or conversion until a later money ADR (ADR-012, ADR-025). Live's cosmetics become the first kinds, migrated convert-verify-delete. Profiles are Network's and read the showcase here.
